interventions.detail: Used Python 3.11 venv via uv (image ships 3.12; setup.py lists up to 3.11)
Pinned protobuf<3.21 because s2clientprotocol generated protos fail with protobuf 4+
Pinned numpy<2 as a precaution for old code
sc_process._launch forwarded extra_ports kwarg to subprocess.Popen (TypeError); drop it before Popen
Installed unzip to extract the SC2 Linux package and mini_games.zip
Chose SC2.4.10 Linux package and extracted with Blizzard's EULA archive password
